description:
Catalogue of Gene Symbols for Wheat (McIntosh et al., GrainGenes; 2024 edition): the official register of
designated wheat genes and alleles. query: a gene or allele symbol ('Lr34', 'Rht-B1b'), locus ('Rht-B1' lists
all its alleles), old synonym ('Rht1', 'Ppd1', 'NAM-B1'), trait words matching a catalogue section ('stem rust',
'height', 'vernalization', 'glutenin') or any text (a cultivar, marker or stock name). chromosome filters by arm
or chromosome ('2D', '7DS'). Each entry gives its section, synonyms, chromosome, the catalogue text (stocks
i:/v:, markers ma:, cloning c:) and, with full, the cited references resolved. Use resolve_gene for the IWGSC
gene ID of cloned genes.
name: wheat_gene_catalogue
